rules.statement: The complaint provides comprehensive information regarding the respondents' actions intended to deprive the plaintiffs of their right to own and possess the subject matter of the dispute.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The Plaint gives full details regarding the conduct of the Respondents to deprive the Plaintiffs right to own and possess the subject matter of the action. (2) The Plaintiff pleads in paragraph 17 that a cause of action has arisen to evict the Defendant and place the Plaintiff in possession of the land. (3) There is only one cause of action. The prayer for invalidation of the two deeds is consequential to prevent the Respondents from alienating the land. (4) It is wrong to prevent the alleged actions of the Defendants and to invalidate any illegal transfers or alienation
